name: RefSpatial-Bench
intro: RefSpatial-Bench是一个具有挑战性的基准测试，旨在评估视觉语言模型在多步空间指代推理方面的能力。它基于真实世界中的杂乱场景，并包含大规模的问答对，涵盖了丰富的空间关系和复杂的推理过程。该基准测试填补了现有评估方法在多步空间推理方面的空白，并能有效区分不同模型的性能。
org: Beihang University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
intro_en: RefSpatial-Bench is a challenging benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of vision-language models in multi-step spatial coreference reasoning. It is based on cluttered real-world scenes and includes a large-scale set of question-answer pairs covering rich spatial relationships and complex reasoning processes. This benchmark fills the gap in existing evaluation methods for multi-step spatial reasoning and effectively differentiates the performance of various models.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with RoboRefer arXiv:2506.04308 Section 3.3, benchmark and evaluation sections, and appendices, cross-checked against BAAI/RefSpatial-Bench. RefSpatial-Bench is the held-out multi-step spatial-referring benchmark introduced with RoboRefer. Its parent RefSpatial pipeline combines filtered OpenImages, sampled CA-1M embodied-video frames, and simulated Infinigen scenes using manually screened Objaverse-LVIS assets; the full resource spans 2.5 million samples, 20 million QA pairs, 31 relations, and reasoning chains up to five steps. The released benchmark has Location, Placement, and Unseen-composition folders, each pairing RGB images and target masks with prompts, category labels, and step counts. Models return point-coordinate tuples, which are checked against the target regions and summarized as split and average accuracy.
